label: Kant's thesis: no reality feature is EXISTENCE_8 at the selected world
paraphrase: Rival, analyst formulation of Kant's thesis that being is not a real predicate (A598/B626, navigation; attribution deferred): no positive reality of the profile is had by exactly the candidates that exist at the selected world. On Kant's positive account existence is the positing of a thing with its determinations, the instantiation sense EXISTENCE_1, not a further determination.
